scope: Isolated physical-cell grid rendering; not complete-world frame time

implementation.submission: One ordinary indexed triangle draw per existing bounded batch; four shared vertex IDs and two triangles per edge; gl_VertexID fetches edge/corner textures
implementation.source: RGBA32F(direction.xyz,height), normalized R8 dry-land coverage, RG16UI endpoint pairs; texture-row padding retained in canonical packets

maximumPacketFallback.trigger: 16,384 rendered segments (all 8,192 source edges split at the map seam)
maximumPacketFallback.allocation: Lazy; shared across all maximum-capacity batches and counted once. Avoids WebGL2 Uint16 primitive restart at index65535. Common benchmark byte counts remain unchanged.

timing.method: Two warmup renders, then six frames per round; synchronous full-frame readPixels included; alternating baseline/current/baseline/current
timing.limitation: Cloud software rasterization, synchronous readback, short sample, and concurrent QA load produce noisy tails. These are not interactive FPS estimates or hardware GPU measurements. Thicker triangle strokes cost about 2.3 times the baseline median in these rounds; unchanged draw-call count does not imply unchanged GPU cost.
